method_note: All pages read live via Apify web-fetch on 2026-11-17; Bali URLs found with one Firecrawl map (search 'bali'). No site/ drafts, no competitor pages. Live pages use em and en dashes; quotes below replace them with commas or hyphens and must not reintroduce them.

facts.claim: Our packages page says: "Every package is fully curated: the venue, the ceremony setup, an on-the-ground planner, photography, and accommodation for you and your guests". FAQ adds: "Specific inclusions vary by resort and are sent through after you enquire".
facts.source_name: Wedded Wonderland, All-Inclusive Destination Wedding Packages
facts.use_note: Own brand page. Always pair with 'inclusions vary by resort'.

facts.claim: Packages page list 'Included in every package': venue and wedding date secured; a group room block held for your guests; guest travel and transfers, coordinated; an on-the-ground planner from enquiry to send-off; photography, styling and ceremony setup; local legal and cultural requirements, handled; a celebration that runs without you managing it.
facts.source_name: Wedded Wonderland, All-Inclusive Destination Wedding Packages
facts.use_note: Same page's table says guest accommodation and legal/documentation are 'Paid separately'. 'Coordinated/handled' means arranged, not paid for. Do not imply guest rooms or legal fees are in the price.

facts.claim: Packages page inclusions table: Ceremony venue and styling, Dedicated planner and concierge, The couple's accommodation = 'Included in every package'; Photography = 'Included, or arranged at preferred rates'; Guest accommodation = 'Paid separately, usually at negotiated group rates'; Legal and documentation = 'Paid separately, destination-dependent'; Extras such as spa, excursions or additional events = 'Paid separately, on request'. FAQ adds flights are typically paid separately.
facts.source_name: Wedded Wonderland, All-Inclusive Destination Wedding Packages
facts.use_note: Best single source for 'what is and is not included'.

facts.claim: Bali properties in our nine-package edit: Akohara Buahan Village Retreat ('In the highlands above Ubud'), Regent Bali Canggu ('oceanfront ceremony spaces with the service depth to carry a larger guest list'), The Apurva Kempinski Bali ('rising up the cliffs of Nusa Dua... ballrooms built for celebration at scale').
facts.source_name: Wedded Wonderland, All-Inclusive Destination Wedding Packages
facts.use_note: No prices or guest numbers shown for these three. Concierge page collection lists AYANA Bali, Regent Bali Canggu, The Apurva Kempinski Bali (AYANA card reuses the Akohara image).

facts.claim: Lead time: '12-18 months is the comfortable lead time for luxury destination weddings'. Shorter timelines 'are workable in less seasonal regions'.
facts.use_note: Consistent with F-013 (premium Bali venues book out 12-18 months ahead in peak season).

facts.claim: Package process: five steps, 'Share your vision', 'Meet your specialist', 'Choose your destination' (tailored shortlist 'with inclusions, dates and pricing made clear'), 'Leave the coordination to your team', 'Arrive and celebrate'. Package details are emailed after an enquiry with date and approximate guest count.
facts.use_note: Differs from the six-step concierge 'How It Works'; do not mix step names.

facts.claim: Bali destination page venues: Nirjhara Bali Waterfall Weddings, Conrad Bali, AYANA Bali, Grand Hyatt Bali, Alila Villas Uluwatu, Jumeirah Bali, Samabe Bali Suites & Villas. Areas: Uluwatu (clifftop, featured Alila Villas Uluwatu); Seminyak and Canggu (beachfront); Nusa Dua and Jimbaran (resort, featured Ayana Bali, Jumeirah Bali, Grand Hyatt Bali, Samabe).
facts.use_note: Jumeirah Bali's own listing says Pecatu (Uluwatu side), not Nusa Dua/Jimbaran. Verify before stating its area.

facts.claim: Bali destination page costs: 'Intimate or elopement: from around AUD $5,000'; 'Resort or chapel wedding: roughly $5,000 to $15,000+'; 'Private luxury villa: villa hire from around $1,500 per night; full estate events up to $40,000+'; 'Catering: roughly $50 to $90 per guest'; overall 'around AUD $5,000 ... to $50,000 or more'.
facts.use_note: CONFLICT with our own 2026 cost guide (F-013) and with live venue package prices (F-011: Conrad 100-guest package AUD 34,513). Unsourced and too low for AUD 150K+ readers. Do not use.

facts.claim: Bali page legal wording: 'Indonesia's legal marriage requirements are strict, so most couples from Australia, India, and the UK complete the legal paperwork in their home country and hold a symbolic ceremony in Bali.' FAQ: this 'avoids Indonesia's complex local marriage requirements'.
facts.use_note: Brand positioning only. Not a legal source. Batch B must confirm with Australian (Attorney-General's / BDM / Smartraveller) and Indonesian official sources.

facts.claim: Bali page: 'The dry season, April to October, has the most reliable weather for outdoor ceremonies.' Our cost guide quotes planner Nicky Almeida: peak season June-August; shoulder season November-March can save 10-20% on venue costs with 'a slightly higher chance of rain'.
facts.source_name: Wedded Wonderland, Weddings in Bali; Bali Wedding Cost 2026 Guide
facts.use_note: Season claims need an official climate source (BMKG or tourism board) from batch B. Calling Nov-Mar 'shoulder' conflicts with it being Bali's wet season.

facts.claim: Conrad Bali listing on our site shows packages priced in AUD: Celebration Package up to 25 guests AUD 18,753.50; 50 guests AUD 22,693.00; 100 guests AUD 34,513.00; 150 guests AUD 42,390.00; 200 guests AUD 54,997.00; 250 guests AUD 62,883.00. Reception Package from AUD 16,392.00 (25) to AUD 60,510.00 (250). Ceremony Only up to 50 guests AUD 9,299.00. Reception Only AUD 221.00 per person. Celebration inclusions: 2 nights accommodation (3 Conrad Suites plus 7 to 17 Deluxe Garden Rooms), one hour in Infinity Chapel, Tiffany chairs up to 50, flowers, bridal prep room, non-alcoholic toast, garden dinner 7 to 10 PM, canapes, 3 hours soft drinks, dance floor and stage, couple's 60-minute massage. Ceremony Only includes 'Wedding Celebrant (non religious / non legal)'.
facts.source_name: Wedded Wonderland venue listing, Conrad Bali
facts.use_note: Best concrete example of what a Bali resort package includes and excludes (no alcohol, 1-hour chapel). Header on same page says 'From USD 7,050.00', which conflicts with the AUD offers. Cross-check on conradbali.com before use; Nic signoff.

facts.claim: Nirjhara Bali Waterfall Weddings (Tabanan) listing, header 'From USD 2,000.00'. Offers 'Starting from': Balinese Wedding Ceremony up to 2 guests USD 2,000; Serenity Elopement up to 2 guests USD 3,000; Intimate Wedding by the Waterfall up to 12 guests USD 9,000; Scenic Tropical Wedding up to 20 guests USD 13,000; Resort Exclusivity up to 60 guests USD 28,000 (two-night buyout of all 25 units). IDR 10,000,000 refundable security deposit per event; music ends 10 PM for non-buyout events; fireworks need hotel approval and police and village permits. Capacity 150 seated.
facts.use_note: USD only. Good for 'buyout' and 'curfew/permit' points. Nic signoff on any price.

facts.claim: Our 2026 cost guide (planner Nicky Almeida, Nix Wedding Planner; 'All figures in USD'): 100-guest Bali wedding budget USD $38,000-$84,000, luxury 'comfortably exceeding $112,000+'. Planner 10-15% of total. Hidden costs include banjar (local community) fees, generator hire, overtime, corkage, wet weather marquees, government taxes and service charges. Suppliers usually take 30-50% deposit, balance 30-60 days before. Legal marriage in Indonesia costs 'generally sit between $750-$2,250'. Premium venues book out 12-18 months ahead.
facts.source_name: Wedded Wonderland, Bali Wedding Cost: The Complete 2026 Guide
facts.use_note: Own editorial quoting a third-party planner, USD. Fits AUD 150K+ audience better than F-008. Legal fee range is planner opinion, not official.

facts.claim: AYANA Bali listing: 'From USD 11,280.00'; capacity 1260 seated; 9 event spaces including SKY (400 seated), AYANA Villa (180), Tresna Chapel (70), KISIK Pier (70), Champa Garden (600), Grand Ballroom 'Opening September 1, 2026'; 993 guest rooms, suites and villas across four hotels on a 90-hectare estate. Members-only 'Wedded Perks': accommodation stay in wedding package, complimentary 60-minute Balinese massage for the couple, 10% off AYANA Spa.
facts.source_name: Wedded Wonderland venue listing, AYANA Bali
facts.use_note: Internal conflict: Grand Ballroom card says '1260 seated' but text says 'seating up to 2,300 guests'. Verify on ayana.com before quoting capacity.

facts.claim: Venue capacities on our listings: Alila Villas Uluwatu 200 seated (no price shown); Conrad Bali 250 seated (Infinity Chapel 70, Ocean and Infinity Garden 250, Beach 100, Grand Ballroom 250); Samabe 300; Grand Hyatt Bali 300; Jumeirah Bali 300; Nirjhara 150.
facts.source_name: Wedded Wonderland venue listings (Alila, Conrad, similar-venue cards)
facts.use_note: Samabe, Grand Hyatt, Jumeirah figures come from 'similar venues' cards only; their own pages not read in this batch.

facts.claim: Concierge for Bali: Bali page calls it 'our complimentary Wedded Concierge' that 'connects you with vetted venues and planners and handles the details from afar'. The concierge page describes 'Venue sourcing and planner recommendations', 'Guest travel and accommodation concierge', 'Currency and international payments coordinated', and states 'We are not a traditional wedding planner'. Shortlists: 'approximately 5-10 venues', venue shortlists 'within 7-14 business days', planners 5-7, vendors 5-10 business days.
facts.source_name: Wedded Wonderland, Destination Wedding Planner & Concierge
facts.use_note: CONFLICT: Bali page says 'complimentary'; concierge page sells it from US$5,500 (only the Discovery Call is free). Packages page says a planner is 'built into every package' while concierge page says 'we may recommend a planner'. Use 'free Discovery Call' only until Nic resolves.

facts.claim: Concierge page discloses: 'When a client books with one of our partners, the partner may pay Wedded Wonderland a booking fee.' Wonderland Benefits (suite upgrades, property credit per booked room, breakfast, late checkout, group rates) 'apply at our partner, preferred and consortia properties and vary by hotel and by program'.
facts.source_name: Wedded Wonderland, Destination Wedding Planner & Concierge
facts.use_note: Always keep the 'vary by hotel' qualifier. Disclosure is useful for trust.

facts.claim: Trust numbers conflict across our pages: packages page shows '10,000+ Weddings Curated', '75+ Countries', '1,200+ Curated Partners'; concierge page shows '800+ Weddings and celebrations', '54 Countries', '50k+ Vetted vendors'.
facts.source_name: Wedded Wonderland, packages vs concierge pages
facts.use_note: brand-profile.md uses 800+. Do not use 10,000+ until confirmed.

legal.summary: Brand pages only: most Australian couples do legal paperwork at home and hold a symbolic ceremony in Bali; Conrad Ceremony Only celebrant is 'non religious / non legal'; packages table lists 'Legal and documentation' as 'Paid separately'. No official source read in this batch.
